profile.headline: PHP Engineer | Full-Stack | AI-Assisted Development
profile.summary:
Senior PHP engineer with 10+ years building and modernizing production web platforms — from high-traffic content systems serving millions of monthly visitors to payment, SSO, and third-party integrations on platforms supporting hundreds of thousands of users. My core depth is PHP, Drupal, and MySQL, with solid Symfony, REST-API integration, and automated testing (PHPUnit, Behat).
For the past year-plus, AI-assisted development has become the way I actually work, not a tool I'm easing into. Claude Code is my daily driver alongside GitHub Copilot, and I've moved quickly into multi-agent workflows — a lead agent coordinating parallel sub-agents across planning, implementation, testing, and review. I've also contributed to the shared AI scaffolding my team builds its workflow around.
I do my best work owning back-end systems end-to-end in remote, cross-functional teams, and I care about engineering practices that make a whole team faster — not just me.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Software Engineer focused on building and maintaining secure, scalable Drupal solutions that support learner engagement and revenue‑generating workflows. Experienced in platform modernization, Salesforce and payment integrations, and applying AI‑assisted development practices to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational reliability.

- Drive AI-native engineering: develop daily in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, including multi-agent orchestration (a lead agent coordinating parallel sub-agents), and contribute to the team's shared Claude scaffolding and AI-assisted workflows.
- Delivered and maintained critical Drupal platform functionality supporting Becker.com, with a focus on performance, security, and integration with Salesforce and payment systems, contributing to a stable and reliable learner experience.
- Led and executed Drupal platform upgrades and dependency modernization efforts (Drupal Core, PHP tooling, Drush, modules), reducing technical debt and maintaining compliance with security and community support standards.
- Played a key role in Salesforce–Drupal replatforming initiatives, including retiring Salesforce Communities and migrating learner‑facing functionality to Drupal backed by LMS APIs.
- Expanded automated testing capabilities by implementing PHP unit testing for custom Drupal code, improving defect detection and code reliability.
- Contributed to a Cybersource Token Management Service (TMS) upgrade and guest-checkout / conversion improvements supporting secure payments and e-commerce performance.
- Actively applied AI‑assisted development practices to accelerate implementation, troubleshooting, and test creation, improving delivery efficiency and code quality across Drupal initiatives.
- Collaborated closely with cross‑functional partners and senior engineers to plan, scope, and deliver complex platform changes while maintaining operational stability.
positions.insights: Skills: Claude Code · AI-Assisted Development · PHP · MySQL · Agentic Workflows · Drupal · GitHub Copilot · Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) · Multi-Agent Orchestration

positions.title: Owner, Developer, and Consultant
positions.description:
Providing independent consulting services for small businesses and non-profit organizations. Specializing in Drupal-based web services and technical solutions.

- Leverage Claude Code across consulting engagements — including ongoing backend work for a union web services client — to accelerate integrations, maintenance, and modernization.
- Drupal 7, Drupal 8, CivCRM, and WordPress site builder, supporter, and maintainer.
- Technical support provider for troubleshooting local & remote web hosting environments.
- Data management consultant for a large union operations organization.
- Back-end enhancement & support developer for non-profit Drupal 7 e-commerce site.
- Lead support developer for Daniel Biss Gubernatorial campaign WordPress site.
- Hosting optimization centered around Digital Ocean, AWS, Platform.sh, and Pantheon.
- Extensive experience with e-commerce, networking, business management, and accounting.
positions.insights: Skills: Claude Code · AI-Assisted Development · PHP · MySQL · Agentic Workflows · Drupal

positions.title: Drupal Developer
positions.description:
• Cleaning large databases and preparing custom code for migration from Drupal 7 to Drupal 8.
• Maintaining five revenue-critical Drupal 7 sites as well as one Vanilla Forums site.
• Creating a variety of D7 & D8 modules for enhanced administrative and viewer experience.
• Leveraging Drupal API to deploy content and configuration changes in a repeatable fashion.
• Developing complex, dynamic MySQL queries for advanced content reporting.
• Leveraging Behat PHP framework to develop extensive automated test suite.
• Provisioning, tuning, and managing Ubuntu-Nginx-MariaDB servers with SaltStack and SSH.

positions.title: Support Developer
positions.description:
• Support developer, security maintainer, and project estimator for a variety of Drupal 6-8 sites.
• Maintained Docker and Vagrant based packages for fast and flexible local development.
• Administered a variety of cloud-based Apache and Nginx web servers for sites of all sizes.

positions.title: Junior Developer & Technical Analyst
positions.description:
• Back-end developer for Drupal e-commerce sites
--> Dealt in both Waterfall- and Agile-based development methodologies.
--> Responded to project scope changes quickly and dynamically.
--> Transformed conceptual artistic wireframe renderings into interactive site experiences.
--> Worked with LAMP-based web development technologies.
--> Utilized Drupal module design and responsive theming best practices.
• Security maintainer and enhancements engineer for numerous Drupal and Magento sites
--> Deployed security updates to Drupal and Magento projects, from small municipality sites to large international e-commerce platforms.
--> Utilized bug tracking & version control utilities for efficient team-oriented programming.
• DevOps engineer for improved development team efficiency
--> Stood up numerous Rackspace virtual machines for LAMP-based web development.
--> Developed complex Bash scripts for generating Chef-based Vagrant environments.
--> Engineered Selenium-based automated test scripts for New Relic Synthetics.
--> Wrote detailed Wiki articles for in-house best practices & FAQ documentation.

positions.title: Structural Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a Tollway Plaza Database – An interactive Microsoft Access database cataloguing plaza details, enhanced with Visual Basic for easy data search, input, and manipulation.
--> Implemented such features as automated report generation with linked photo thumbnails, OLE embedded & linked files, and an easy-to-navigate menu system.
--> Created numerous queries and tables to analyze pavement condition and lane statistics.
• Developed a Lake County Roadway Drainage Structure Assessments Database – A database cataloguing field observations and measurements for the repair/improvement of drainage structures in Lake County.
--> Constructed a database to store photos, field observations and measurements.
--> Leveraged data to generate repair and improvement recommendations for use in schedules and contract plans.
--> Prepared a photo log of each location for use by the Resident Engineer to help define the improvements.
• Served as Information Systems emergency technician for O’Hare office.
--> Replaced computer components such as hard drives, memory, and power supplies.
--> Assisted co-workers with troubleshooting & improving hardware and software applications.

positions.title: Scoreboard Operations Crew Member
positions.description:
•	In-House Audio/Visual Media Productions – Provided 13 seasons of loyal, productive expertise in a live, high-pressure environment as a producer, operator, and logger.
-->	Training with tape decks, A/V computer media systems, and logging systems.
-->	Logged live events for Major League Baseball highlight reels.
-->	Queued and rolled animations for presentation on the Jumbotron Scoreboard in center field.

positions.title: Computer Services Assistant
positions.description:
-->	Designed and maintained a web site for Community Care Options (now Pillars), a large multi-city public healthcare organization.
-->	Maintained a Windows NT-based computer network essential to C.C.O. operations.
-->	Trained social workers on the use and maintenance of spreadsheets & databases.
-->	Consulted on computer-related issues with The Architectural Partnership in Chicago.
